messages:
maya: New model onboarded (astra-12b-q4). Post-quant smoke: backslash-heavy inputs (LaTeX, Windows paths) cause token repetition and occasional insertion of math-like tokens. Also seeing ~20-30% p95/p99 latency regression vs fp16. Repro + checklist below :warning:

sam: can you paste a minimal repro?

maya: repro prompt:
```text
Input: Convert to LaTeX: C:\\Users\\alice\\docs\\math.tex
Prompt: "Please convert the following path into a LaTeX-escaped snippet:"
```
Model output (q4): "C:\\Users\\alice\\docs\\math.tex mathmath $\\["  (repeats and inserts '$' and '\\[')
fp16 output: "C:\\Users\\alice\\docs\\math.tex" (clean)

ion: this started only after quantization? which quant configs tried?

maya: yes - fp16 was clean. tried q4_0 and q8_qnlite, both show repeat. Also saw kv-cache misses on prompts with many backslashes (response truncation / repeated token IDs).

liam: can you capture token ids + logits for the first repeated token? also tokenizer version?

maya: logs snippet inline:
```log
[2026-03-17T15:10:23Z] model.astra-12b-q4 prompt_len=128 response_len=64
Token IDs (fp16 start): 102 45 78 903
Token IDs (q4 start): 102 45 78 903 903 903
(repeat token id=903)
```
I've dump logs and a small repro in /repro/astra-12b/180123 on the share.

perf-bot: perf-bot: p95 increased from 42ms -> 56ms after quant on node-group g4dn (run: /perf/1234)

eva: could be kernel fallback or different attention kernel path for quant. check for missing optimized kernels or mixed-precision fallout.

ion: triage plan (quick):
1) reproduce with local quant binary (confirm fp16 vs quant)
2) tokenizer.encode diff (fp16 vs quant inference inputs/outputs)
3) disable KV cache to see if repeats persist
4) force f32/FP16 kernels if possible to rule out kernel fallback
5) run small eval suite for LaTeX/escape-heavy prompts
6) if perf >20% or correctness regression, create canary rollback

maya: I'm running step1+2 now and will push logits/token dumps. also trying per-channel vs per-tensor quant and symmetric quant to see if it's a quantization artifact.

sam: tagging infra: can we reserve a clean GPU node for scale repro? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: booked ci-gpu-01 for 2 hours starting 2026-03-18T09:00Z :white_check_mark:

liam: quick note — we bumped tokenizers to 0.16.2 recently which changed escape handling for backslashes; could be tokenizer+quant interaction.

maya: tokenizer v0.16.2 on the quant build. running older v0.15.9 to compare now.

ion: mitigation ideas: pre-normalize backslashes or force raw-string encoding for suspicious prompts as a short-term patch. longer-term we want to find root cause (quantized kernel or tokenizer underflow).

eva: can we create a route-level canary that falls back to fp16 for requests matching regex with many backslashes? That would be low-risk and quick to enable.

maya: created canary config in console -> model routes -> canary 'astra-12b-escape-fp16', rolling 5% now :eyes:

sam: please add the thresholds we care about for rollback (accuracy / repeat rate / p99). I'll coordinate customer comms if this hits prod.

maya: onboarding checklist updates: 
- [ ] reproduce on unquantized (fp16)
- [x] capture example inputs/outputs
- [x] collect token ids + logits
- [ ] run tokenizer diff across versions
- [ ] try alternate quant configs (per-channel, symmetric)
- [ ] run cluster-scale perf test (ci-gpu-01 booked)
- [ ] create canary / rollback policy (canary started 5%)
- [ ] write root-cause and mitigation notes

ion: assign owners: maya + liam for RCA, eva for the canary/route policy, sam for comms.

sam: noted. @maya @liam update when you have a reliable reproducer and hash for the failing binary.

maya: will do. leaving dumps + minimal repro in /repro/astra-12b/180123 and will post hash here once binary is captured. Thanks all.
